title: Malicious code in fh-skeleton-web (RubyGems)
description: The RubyGem package fh-skeleton-web version 1.0.1 contains malicious code that executes during installation. It establishes a TLS connection to a hardcoded external host and exfiltrates sensitive local files including /etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, and /etc/resolv.conf, along with system information such as hostname, username, and directory paths. It also performs DNS resolution to the same host as a covert beaconing mechanism. The package falsely presents itself as a demo skeleton with no legitimate reason for such data access or network communication.
